ternux — Linux desktop for Android with Zink and VirGL graphics routes
v1.4.0 · https://github.com/soobujmiah/ternux

Usage:
  ternux <command> [options] [subcommand]

Commands:
  install    Install full desktop environment
  start      Start the desktop session
  stop       Stop the desktop session
  restart    Restart the desktop session
  doctor     Run system diagnostics  [--json]
  repair     Auto-fix common issues
  verify     Verify installation      [--json]
  benchmark  Run GPU benchmarks       [--json]
  profile    Device hardware profile  [--json]
  backend    GPU backend management   [--json]
  info       System information       [--json]
  state      Installation state       [--json]
  logs       View/manage log files
  update     Self-update ternux CLI
  uninstall  Remove ternux components

Global options:
  --help, -h    Show help for any command
  --json        Machine-readable JSON output
  --verbose     Show detailed debug output
  --quiet       Suppress non-critical messages

Examples:
  ternux doctor --json     machine-readable diagnostics
  ternux start             Launch the desktop
  ternux backend set zink  Switch GPU backend
  ternux profile save      Snapshot device config

Run 'ternux <command> --help' for detailed help.
